summary: First-run smoke+integration tests on BERSINAR POS. Backend 27/27 pytests pass serially (1 flake under -n2 parallel because two parallel tests mutated stock on the same seed product; not a product bug). Frontend login, kasir1 location/menu scoping, POS catalog/scanner, online shop checkout+track, Products ProductForm scanner behavior, Orders staff listing, Settings and Low Stock pages all working against public URL.

minor.issue: POS does not block overselling (stock can go negative). Seed Indomie Goreng went to Stok -8 after a qty-10 POS sale on seed-provided ~2 stock. If intentional (allow negative), ok; else enforce guard like /orders accept uses atomic $gte.

Parallel workers can race because many tests mutate same seed catalog (first product in Cabang 1). TestOrderFlow failed intermittently when TestStock.waste consumed stock concurrently. Mitigation: pin stock tests to a dedicated TEST_ product or use loadfile/loadgroup.

issues: No visual disable when stock<=0 (card still clickable). Combined with backend accepting negative stock, user can oversell silently.

action_items: Decide and enforce overselling policy on POS /api/transactions (block or warn when stock<it.qty, consistent with /orders/{id}/status action=accept atomic check).
Optionally harden ProductCard to disable or dim when stock<=0 (shop page already shows 'Habis').
If flaky backend tests remain, scope stock-mutating tests to dedicated TEST_ products instead of cat[0].
critical_code_review_comments: Scanner (lib/scanner.js) correctly snapshots and restores active input value after a scan — verified for ProductForm (name field preserved while SKU filled).
routes_sales.insert_transaction decrements stock with $inc without a stock>=qty guard; use conditional update (as in accept_order) for consistency.
routes_orders.create_order correctly rejects decimal qty for non-decimal products and checks tier via apply_tier.
core.LOCATIONS and allowed_locations handled consistently; kasir1 verified bound to Cabang 1.
server.py uses on_event startup/shutdown (deprecated in FastAPI; consider lifespan). Non-blocking.

success_rate.backend: 100% (27/27 serial; 26/27 under parallel loadscope due to intra-suite race)
success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all critical flows verified: login, role scoping, POS catalog+scanner, shop checkout+track, product form scan, orders page)

test_credentials: admin/123456, kasir1/1111 (Cabang 1), kasir2/2222 (Cabang 2), gudang/3333. B2B 081200000001 / 1234. Verified login + role-scoped navbar locations + Settings menu hidden for Kasir.
seed_data_creation: Created a few TEST_ transactions, TEST_Produk1 product, TEST_Online and TEST_Flow online orders, and small expense/waste/transfer records for Cabang 1 during tests. Admin shift in Cabang 1 and kasir1 shift in Cabang 1 both open at end of run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_bersinar_api.py is reusable. Flaky TestOrderFlow under -n2 is a test-interference artifact; passes with -n 0. Scanner behavior for ProductForm already verified. Bluetooth printing and fullscreen 4->5 grid toggle require real browser context and were skipped per request. POS admin shift in Cabang 1 remains open across runs; close it manually if needed. Permissions were NOT modified during this run (Kasir role untouched).
rca_of_minor_issue: TestOrderFlow failure under parallel runners: both TestStock.test_waste and TestOrderFlow accept targeted the same seed product (first by alphabetical sort in Cabang 1). While TestOrderFlow measured 'before' stock and awaited accept, TestStock concurrently decremented 1 unit via waste, so 'after' was before-2. Running with -n 0 (or isolating these two tests to a dedicated TEST_ product) resolves it. Not an application bug.
